messages:
samir: Heads up — we're seeing outgoing paging fail for the Pager -> SMS relay. Incidentbot didn't auto-escalate. Customers reported missed pages. Investigating now.
pagerbot: system: attempted deliveries=47, success=3, acks=0, error_rate=93% :rotating_light:
jess: omg — which relay? twilio or our notify-relay?
samir: looks like notify-relay -> twilio. TL;DR: upstream 502s and a new header we don't parse. grabbing logs.
liam: copying logs from relay: ```2026-03-17T12:04:01Z ERROR relay_outbound: 502 BadGateway, response_headers: {"x-msg-id":"abc123","x-pager-chan":"sms;v2"} parse_err: unexpected header format
2026-03-17T12:04:02Z WARN retrying delivery id=abc123 attempt=3
```
karen: incident-bot didn't page oncall because the channel filter returned empty on the notify webhook. suspect header mismatch in signature verifier.
incident-bot: system: received webhook id=abc123, channel_tags=["paging:sms"], matched_routes=[]
liam: I can flip the manual fallback to sms-relay-legacy to get pages flowing. Recommend manual override for next 10m.
samir: do it. @karen please coordinate live handoff to ops-oncall and keep customers updated. mention manual_escalation in incident channel.
karen: manual override in place: ```POST /v1/relays/override {"relay":"sms-relay-legacy","ttl":600}``` pages should start again in ~20s
pagerbot: system: retry deliveries to 47 recipients via sms-relay-legacy — success=45, failures=2
jess: nice — two failures were invalid phone numbers from retention test account, not customer-impacting.
liam: root cause looks like a header encoding change from upstream proxy that adds a semi-colon in x-pager-chan, our parser treats that as list delimiter and fails validation.
infra-bot: rolling out hotfix branch relay/header-tolerate; patch deployed to staging. request for prod hotfix approval?
samir: approve. patch LGTM. rolling to prod with canary=10% then 100% if green.
incident-bot: note: automated escalation was suppressed due to matcher returning empty; added temporary alert rule to page on delivery_failures > 10 in 5m.
karen: live handoff: ops-oncall @liam taking incident. customers impacted: ~44 pages delayed/missed for 3m window; on-call notified via manual SMS fallback. Customer-facing note drafted: "We experienced transient paging delivery failures to SMS between 12:03-12:07 UTC due to a header parsing regression. Fallback was activated; no further pages missed after 12:05 UTC."
samir: thanks. postmortem owners: liam (root cause & fix), jess (customer comms), karen (pagerbot rules). I'll create the incident ticket and link this thread. Closing live coordination here — followups in #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
